data.body: HOT-PATH FIX (defense-mirror pollution, 2026-06-04, commit 0b51459cf6 on story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/defense-mirror-scoping). The CI 'Mirror Tracker Defenses to PR' producer iterated ALL 660 tickets-ref defense blobs and re-posted any whose cited FILE was in the PR diff -> historical defenses on hot files accumulated unbounded. FULL 4-REVIEWER PANEL: rejected the maintainer-named 'change --pr to --pr-number' (pr_number is the dormant sentinel 0; wrong key in two-tier) AND the opus-recommended 'Option A SHA-range ancestry' (squash/rebase/force-push fragility via _squash_rebase_recovery; shallow-clone breaks --is-ancestor; SHA fields also dormant; doesn't bound the existing 657 corpus). CONVERGED on DIFF-HUNK overlap: emit a defense only if a cited line is within +-5 of a line THIS PR actually changed (git diff base...head --unified=0; same +-5 axis as runner.py suppression). No write-side change, immune to squash/rebase/shallow-clone. Convergence caught N-1 (proximity not exact-hunk), N-2 (lineno parse), N-4 (measured: all 94 records have cited_lines, 0 file_paths-only). LIVE-VERIFIED on the 94-record corpus: an unrelated diff emits 0 of 94 (pollution gone); a diff touching the exact cited line check-referential-integrity.sh:98 emits exactly 1 of 94 (the defense citing it) — both halves of the goal proven. ci.yml mirror job wired (fetch-depth:0 + base fetch + --base-sha/--head-sha). DEFERRED (separable, zero-behavior): drop pr_number from cited_lines_fingerprint. Test 6/6, shellcheck clean. Landing via two-tier.
